# Local MP3 encoder

lamejs 1.2.1 by Alex Zhukov, based on jump3r and LAME, is distributed under LGPL-3.0. It is separate from Studio's MIT code. The npm package was downloaded from the official npm registry and checked against its published SHA-512 integrity; see provenance.json.

- Upstream: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
- LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.io/
- Unmodified browser distribution: lame.min.js
- Readable corresponding browser source: lame.all.js
- Upstream notice: LICENSE; complete license texts: COPYING.LESSER and COPYING.

Studio loads this separate local script only when conversion is requested. No source modifications were made. You may replace or modify the separate library under its license; do not remove its notices. No CDN or server receives audio.
